name: es-foral-income-tax-investment-credits
description: Calculate 2026 foral personal income tax credits for investment, business activity and gifts in Bizkaia, Álava, Gipuzkoa and Navarra. Covers employee share purchases, new or recent company investment with SME, holding and EU risk-finance conditions, territorial business-investment credits calculated first and then limited, the mixed salary and business income credit pool in Bizkaia and Álava, the Gipuzkoa positive-income business-credit pool, and ordinary and designated charitable giving with its territorial methods. Use for deducción por inversión en empresas de nueva creación, adquisición de acciones por trabajadores, deducciones de actividades económicas, límite del 35 por ciento, mecenazgo and donativos in the foral territories. Load es-foral-income-tax first for residence, bases and the quota. Split unchanged from es-foral-income-tax on 6 November 2026.
